groups.description: Live local-delivery marketplaces this domain is modeled on — useful to see how consumer, merchant, and courier surfaces are positioned in practice.

links.title: Uber Eats
links.relevance: The consumer ordering surface for restaurants, grocery, convenience, and retail — the multi-vertical experience the Everyday Local Ordering Consumer evaluates and books against.

links.title: DoorDash for merchants
links.relevance: The supply-side acquisition and growth surface — grounds the Restaurant and Local Retail Operator persona's onboarding, demand-growth, and operations jobs.

links.title: Delivery Hero — brands and countries
links.relevance: Shows the multi-brand, multi-region footprint (foodpanda, talabat, Glovo, PedidosYa) behind the everyday-commerce model this domain captures.

groups.description: Primary-source company reporting on the local-delivery and quick-commerce market — scale, monetization, and the shift from food delivery toward everyday local commerce.

links.title: Delivery Hero — FY 2025 results (Quick Commerce momentum)
links.relevance: Frames the everyday-app, multi-vertical strategy that motivates modeling restaurants, grocery, convenience, and retail in one local commerce domain.

links.title: DoorDash — FY 2025 financial results
links.relevance: Primary-source view of marketplace order volume, merchant sales, and ads monetization that shape the merchant and retail-media themes in this domain.

groups.description: How platforms frame delivery safety and the labor and food-safety rules that govern couriers and merchants.

links.title: Uber — safety
links.relevance: Positions the safety and incident-response controls that the Independent Courier and Everyday Local Ordering Consumer rely on across the delivery flow.

links.title: FDA — Retail Food Protection
links.relevance: The food-safety baseline (handling, temperature, transport) that constrains the Restaurant and Local Retail Operator and grocery/retail delivery workflows.

groups.description: Resources aimed at the delivery supply side — earnings, flexibility, and how courier work is presented.

links.title: DoorDash — become a Dasher
links.relevance: Shows how flexible delivery work, offers, and earnings are presented to the Independent Courier persona whose retention depends on predictable earning time.
